articles.title: How NASA Is Homing in From Space on Ocean Debris
articles.summary: Space-based technology could help track plastic and other flotsam by its ‘fingerprints.’ In late 2025, scientists reported that, for the first time, they were able to detect concentrations of plastic pollution on land using NASA’s Earth Surface Mineral Dust Source Investigation (EMIT) sensor aboard the International Space Station. articles.title: NASA Reveals New Details About Dark Matter’s Influence on Universe
